deviations.description: Rule B threshold set too high for small PTVs with mandible forced into the PTV. When forced = mand_in_ptv - 0.05*ptv_vol > 0.1 and the PTV is small (seen at ptv_vol = 80 cc), the network escalates requests where mand_lim is slightly above cov, by more than 0.3 Gy and up to roughly 0.95 Gy at cov 56 down to 0.5 Gy at cov 78. Rule B requires cov > mand_lim, so the protocol sends these to planning. Observed: cov 56 / mand_lim 56.5 -> +3.5 escalate; cov 70 / mand_lim 70.5 -> +1.2 escalate (mand_in_ptv 28, ptv_vol 80). The PTV-size limit in the condition is an estimate; errors were observed only at ptv_vol 80 with 24 cc forced.
